_note: Ingredients and product classes with a REAL carcinogenicity classification from a named authority, so the app can show a warning that cites its source instead of an unexplained symbol. Three levels, deliberately kept distinct: collapsing IARC Group 1 (known) into Group 2B (possible) would badly mislead - processed meat and a possible-carcinogen sweetener are not the same claim. Nothing goes in this file without a specific citable classification. Deliberately EXCLUDED after checking: BHT (IARC Group 3, 'not classifiable' - no basis to warn); food-grade carrageenan (only DEGRADED carrageenan/poligeenan is Group 2B, the food additive is not); Red 40 / Yellow 5 / Yellow 6 (real concerns exist about hyperactivity and benzidine traces, but these are not classified carcinogens and calling them that would be false).

probable.label: Probable carcinogen
probable.blurb: Classified as probably carcinogenic to humans

possible.label: Possible carcinogen
possible.blurb: Classified as possibly carcinogenic to humans, or restricted by a food-safety regulator

product_classes.label: Processed meat
product_classes.note: Meat preserved by smoking, curing, salting or with added chemical preservatives.

ingredients.label: Nitrites / nitrates
ingredients.note: Ingested nitrite or nitrate under conditions that result in endogenous nitrosation.

ingredients.label: Potassium bromate
ingredients.source: IARC; banned as a food additive in the EU, UK, Canada and Brazil
ingredients.note: A flour improver still permitted in the United States.

ingredients.label: BHA
ingredients.source: IARC; US National Toxicology Program, 'reasonably anticipated to be a human carcinogen'

ingredients.label: Titanium dioxide
ingredients.source: IARC; banned as a food additive in the EU since 2022 after EFSA could not rule out genotoxicity

ingredients.label: Red Dye No. 3
ingredients.source: US FDA, January 2025, under the Delaney Clause
ingredients.note: Erythrosine; causes thyroid tumours in male rats.

ingredients.label: Aspartame
ingredients.note: An artificial sweetener. WHO left the acceptable daily intake unchanged.

ingredients.label: Smoke flavouring
ingredients.note: Carries polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons; EFSA could not rule out genotoxicity for the primary smoke flavourings it reviewed.
